text.text_excerpt: Had a plate from here for dinner. Cool lady serving the food was nice enough to let me try all the chicken because I was so unsure of what to eat at first. Everything smelled and looked so appetizing but I only needed food for 1. I had a piece of fried fish and 2 sides. I was expecting the usual corner store reaction after I took my first bite but I was wrong. The cooks at this particular Cajuns have mastered the art of using the right seasoning to a science! The staff were nice and loaded my plate with food for such a great price. Go there now. You'll definitely become addicted

For local cuisine done good, Today's Cajun Seafood is the place to go. Away from the crowded streets and tourist attractions you will find the hole-in-the-wall food joint that you will be glad to have found. The interior is nothing memorable and the dinning area with a makeshift convenient store shelf feels very out of place. However, the food is delicious and options are plentiful. Customer service is pleasant and prices are some of the best you will find in town. I would recommend the owners to either 1) make the extra space all dining or 2) make the extra space all convenient store items for shopping. I lean more with a legit dining area but either decision would work given cramming bo...

Delicious! Delicious! Delicious!! I ordered a pound of boiled crawfish. Such a bang for my buck. Gumbo was good. Red beans and rice: one of my favorite dishes here. Prices are very reasonable for an entire plate of food and crawfish. It seems that the gumbo and red beans make the price higher. If we didn't get this, my boyfriend and I would have had a huge $12 lunch.
